cards.title: 给Agent装了记忆 封面底图
cards.prompt:
A cinematic ultra-wide 21:9 horizontal composition, deep navy-black to near-black background, cool and restrained. The upper half is mostly empty, clean and dimmed, with large negative space. In the lower-middle area: a stacked glowing translucent stack of document planes forming a tidy square "document block" (each plane shows clear horizontal line textures / subtle grid, but ABSOLUTELY NO writing, letters or numbers), softly lit in cyan at its edges; to the right of the block, many scattered fragment / confetti-like glowing particles are torn apart and drift away into the dark, gradually fading out — one side is "documents organized into a book", the other is "scattered, defocused memory fragments". Cold blue dominant palette with a few small warm amber-gold highlights. Clean, engineered, minimal, not cluttered.

STRICTLY EXCLUDE: any text, letters, digits, symbols, handwriting on the papers, sci-fi HUD panels, robot figures, human faces/people, logos, watermarks, dense particle noise.

Hard requirements: no text anywhere in the image (the golden glowing title will be overlaid later by a script). Main visual concentrated in the lower-middle; the upper area must stay empty and dim. Keep important elements away from all four edges for safe cropping.
